# N Bharath Chowdary

> Founder and CEO of Trinetro Labs, an Automated Intelligence platform for data analysis. AI engineer from Yadgir, Karnataka, India. First-place winner of SCOUT '24 in London (final round: pitching a new sustainable business idea).

This is the personal portfolio at https://kiddosphere.in/. It is one page; every section below is on it.

## Highlights

- SCOUT '24, London (2024): selected from Karnataka among the top 1% of undergraduate students for 15 days of training on entrepreneurship, sustainability in entrepreneurship and business development. The programme ended with a final round in which teams pitched a new business idea in a sustainable way. N Bharath's team won first place.
- Founder and CEO of Trinetro Labs (2024 to present): https://trinetrolabs.com. Ask a question about your data in plain English and get an exact, explainable answer.
- BCA graduate, Government Degree College, Yadgir.
